title: Huda's school day (our own text)
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: School: what school is like (3.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 47 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Huda's day text and questions)
intro: Lesson 47: The school day. Our own text, written for TGA. Read it aloud, then answer the questions.

arabic.text: يَبْدَأُ يَوْمِي الدِّرَاسِيُّ فِي السَّاعَةِ الثَّامِنَةِ وَالنِّصْفِ.
أَدْرُسُ فِي مَدْرَسَةٍ عَلَى الإِنْتَرْنِتِ، لِذٰلِكَ أَبْقَى فِي البَيْتِ.
الدَّرْسُ الأَوَّلُ رِيَاضِيَّاتٌ، وَهِيَ صَعْبَةٌ لٰكِنَّهَا مُفِيدَةٌ.
فِي السَّاعَةِ الحَادِيَةَ عَشْرَةَ عِنْدَنَا اسْتِرَاحَةٌ قَصِيرَةٌ.
نُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ مَعًا فِي السَّاعَةِ الوَاحِدَةِ.
بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ أَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ، ثُمَّ أَلْعَبُ مَعَ أُخْتِي الصَّغِيرَةِ.

questions.q: What time does Huda's school day start?
Why does she stay at home?
questions.a: She studies at an online school.

questions.q: How many lessons does she have each day?
What does she say about maths?
What do they do at one o'clock?
What does she do after school? Give two things.
questions.a: Reads Qur'an; plays with her little sister

questions.q: Why does she like her day?
